title: Good Protection!
text: Good Protection!. I have a white chair in the living room. I also have cats. This chair cover offers good protection from people and cats! It has an elastic strap to keep it in place. It is easy to wash. I like the navy color.

product_metadata.title: TEFLON Newfield Reversible Chair Cover, Chocolate and Tan
features: Each chair measures 75 in. x 70.5 in.
Made with 100% polyester treated with Teflon Eco Elite, an environmentally friendly treatment designed to repel moisture and stains
Chair Cover is made to premium quality standards to help protect your living room furniture against spills, wrinkles, and other daily wear and tear in your home
Cover is machine washable and dryer safe
